prior_finding_assessments.rationale: ProbeSlot.Abandon reaches the shared held release and invokes the fixture’s retained-summon reader. Enabling the modeled tick there registers the queued foreign unit. The no-summon, destroyed-summon and pending-summon controls leave it queued and unrequested. In the pending case, the owned summon receives one request, its identity appears in both the final row and cleanup failure, independent releases run, the original timeout survives, and the next Begin is refused.

Only fixture teardown owns the sentinel registered immediately before the foreign control. A witness request for the control would therefore appear before the sentinel in the request log. Across both witness orders and both release paths, the registered variants require the exact order summon, sentinel, foreign. The unregistered variants require only the summon. All eight variants also retain the genuine unknown, the unsubscribe failure and refusal of the next Begin.
